name: CYP11B2 Selectivity Sentinel MVP

target.sequence_note: Mapped CYP11B2 catalytic-domain sequence from PDB 4FDH.

off_target_panel.why_screened: The principal selectivity liability for aldosterone-synthase inhibitors.
Important steroidogenic off-target to add after the B1/B2 gate.
Potential endocrine off-target; needs its own validated structure/protocol.
Relevant heme-P450 counter-screen, not a substitute for a broader safety panel.

policy.policy_note: A configurable engineering triage threshold, not a clinical safety boundary or universal medicinal-chemistry standard.

limitations: The target sequence and panel are deliberately declared and curated in this MVP; sequence-only genome-wide off-target discovery is future work.
Heme coordination, protonation, membrane environment, and electronic state require target-specific review.
No prospective prediction can establish binding, safety, or clinical selectivity without experimental counterscreens.
